provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Gruddirynn is centered at -72.283919, 77.633589 under Aristocracy, with 30,515,000 people across 11 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Gruddirynn occupies 5,469,689.61 sq mi / 14,166,431.07 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 2.777373% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Beach and grass with water, Beach and reefs with water and Partial forest define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Beach and grass with water, Beach and reefs with water, Farming and Ocean Surface floating settlement. Population density is 2.154 people/sq km / 5.579 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Draconic and Reptilian Races, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi, Hadozee, Triton, Merfolk, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Cog-Sanctum Synod, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Marduthor, Sigrananna, Setrimir, Bastveig, and 3 more.

npcs.name: High Custodian Maxton Vale
npcs.description:
High Custodian Maxton Vale is a young but severe Gnarlborn commander burdened by legacy, prophecy, and the expectation that he must become harder than the collapsing world around him. As a bark-skinned, ancient-tree people shaped by Hathruna’s cycles of rebirth, rot, roots, and living wilderness, Maxton has immense endurance and a deep instinct for preservation, but he twists that protective nature into strict control over dangerous relics, thundercoil arms, ichor-powered engines, and forbidden research.
From the Othéryn Guild Desk, Maxton leads the Crucible Wardens as a disciplined military archivist: recover what can protect settlements, lock away what can corrupt them, and destroy what no mortal institution can safely hold. He is charismatic, ruthless when afraid, genuinely protective of his people, and dangerously convinced that civilization survives only when softer hearts obey those willing to make brutal decisions; Othéryn itself sits among Gruddirynn’s villages, giving him a small frontier post from which to dream far bigger than his station.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Othéryn is a Village in Gruddirynn, under Aristocracy, with elevated danger, Beach and reefs with water, Ocean Surface floating settlement, Beach and grass with water terrain. Local records favor Neutral, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi. Gnarlborn reads through the Gnarlborn entry of the race compendium, within Plantfolk and Nature-Bound Races, marked by Hathruna. Woody, bark-skinned beings shaped from ancient trees that gained sentience through centuries of druidic influence. They are slow-moving but possess immense endurance and natural resilience. Table cues: Deep Roots, Elderwood Whispers, Grasping Branches, Root Sense; starting tendency Altruistic - Neutral - Cooperative - Honorable.
